comparison.objective: Select photo-matching parts from a moving conveyor and assemble a model while staging early arrivals and avoiding a jam.
comparison.physical_skill: Perception-guided interception, temporary parking, sequencing, and multi-part stacking; no fine fastening or force-controlled adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct model composition and geometry plus absence of belt jams and wrong parts determine score.
comparison.reason: This tests visual selection and temporal assembly planning on a conveyor, not damper commissioning. Detailed final pose thresholds are absent from the record body, but no plausible duplicate ability is indicated.
